## HARNESS RUN 30834117797 — the live cell reported the PLATFORM finding, in its distinct shape

Run 30834117797, job 91755000385, main @ `25ead49f3e` — i.e. the first harness run that carries the
merged re-land **1296**. `[jira-live-canary] collected=58 executed=58 skipped=0`, 6 failed / 52
passed. `skipped=0` matters here: a harness-less cell SKIPS rather than fails, so a skip would have
made this unreadable.

**`test_inbound_clear_parent_round_trips` — SETUP FAILED, not a rebar red.** Verbatim:

> SETUP FAILED (not a rebar defect): Data Center REFUSED to clear the parent of sub-task RBJYRMS-2
> — BackendHTTPError: HTTP Error 400: JiraError HTTP 400 url:
> http://localhost:2990/jira/rest/api/2/issue/10029

This is exactly the outcome this ticket predicted ("its live cell may still legitimately report
SETUP FAILED — DC refuses to null a sub-task's fields.parent"), and it arrived in the DISTINCT
shape the cell was rebuilt to produce rather than as an ambiguous red. The prediction was recorded
BEFORE the run, so this is a confirmed forecast rather than a post-hoc rationalisation.

**What it establishes for this ticket:** the harness cannot exercise the inbound parent-clear path
end to end, because the *fixture* cannot get DC into the precondition state — DC will not let the
test null a sub-task's parent in the first place. That is a platform constraint on the TEST, not
evidence about 1296's evidence-gated clear. 1296's correctness rests on the discriminating trio
(measured RED against both wrong states, GREEN against the fix) and the full 2079-passing suite,
both recorded above.

**The rollout behaviour predicted in this ticket is also consistent with this run:** on the first
passes after 1296 no binding carries a recorded peer observation, so nothing is cleared. A green
inbound-clear cell was never expected from this run even had the setup succeeded.

**No new parent-clear regression appeared.** None of the six reds is an inbound parent clear
firing when it should not have — the failure mode that caused the incident. The two parent reds in
this run are the SUB-TASK SET path in both directions, which is a different defect and is now filed
as [rebar:1a9f-50c0-e7a5-4fda].
